name: anim_jyu_twist_RL
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: Facing the viewer with both hands on his hips, he slowly and lewdly twists his body from his right side over to his left side: the hips roll across and rotate, the belly and chest turn from facing his right to facing his left, the shoulders swapping which one is forward, the whole torso twisting at the waist like wringing a towel, the knees flexing as the weight shifts. His head stays upright and keeps facing straight toward the viewer, looking down with the same heavy smug gaze; only the body below the neck turns. The belly and chest lag behind and sag and wobble heavily. Very slow, sticky, syrupy motion. The face keeps exactly the same eyebrows, nose, closed mouth and half-lidded eyes. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
